relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.evidence: Studied at Heidelberg, Ph.D. 1907 (diss. on German history).

relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.evidence: In 1912 took Russian citizenship and orthodox religion and married Ljudmila Levina (—> L. A. Mervart, 1888–1965).

relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.object: Museum of Anthropology and Ethnography (Kunstkamera), St.Petersburg
relations.evidence: From 1913 head of the Indian Department of Museum of Anthropology and Ethnography (Kunstkamera), St.Petersburg.

relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.evidence: In 1914 he went to India with his wife in order to do fieldwork and collect material for the Museum. They worked in Sri Lanka and South India (in Kerala they studied Kathakali)

relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.evidence: Back in Leningrad in 1924-30 he worked as Keeper in Museum of Anthropology and Ethnography and taught at the university.

relations.subject: Aleksandr Mihailovič Mervart
relations.evidence: Back in Leningrad in 1924-30 he worked as Keeper in Museum of Anthropology and Ethnography and taught at the university. He was the first to teach Tamil at a Russian university.
